newsitem.title: UK: Burton jumps on demerger of Debenhams unit.
newsitem.headline: Burton jumps on demerger of Debenhams unit.

text.p: Shares in Burton Group Plc rose sharply in pre-market trading on Tuesday, boosted by the retail group's announcement it was demerging its Debenhams unit in a move it said would "significantly enhance" shareholder value.
By 0716 GMT, shares traded 17-3/4p higher at 132-1/2p on volume of 3.77 million.
Burton said it would seek a separate stock market listing for the household items chain.
The retail group also said that turnover for the 18 weeks to July 4 was up 9.7 percent and at Debenhams was up 14.2 percent.
"Trading is in line with expectations, costs are well under control and, despite the difficult weather in June, the group remains confident for the balance of the year," the company said.
Its pre-market price reached its highest level in a month and was a recovery from the year's low of 112-1/2 touched on Monday.
